India's Women's Cricket Team Exits T20 World Cup, Secures Olympic Berth

The Indian women's cricket team has been eliminated from the T20 World Cup following a loss to Australia. Despite the tournament setback, the team has secured a qualification pathway to the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Discussions are ongoing regarding the team's T20 strategy and tactics following the World Cup exit.
